zh: 什麼時候超越另一輛車屬於合法？
en: When is it legal to drive off the road to pass another vehicle?
options: 倘若有兩條或以上單向行車線。
If there are two or more one-way lanes.
It is not legal under any conditions.
倘若前方車輛正在左轉。
If the vehicle ahead is turning left.
notes: 题意与解析　按英文原题，问题是“什么时候可以为了超过另一辆车而驶离正常行驶的路面？”中文原题漏了这个限定。A 描述同向有多条车道，C 描述前车正在左转；两者都可能让你在路面内合法从右侧通过，却都不允许你绕上路肩。只要超车动作需要驶离正常行驶的路面，这道题就选 B。

The question asks when a driver may leave the traveled roadway to pass. The Chinese stem omits that condition. Multiple lanes in your direction (A) and a vehicle turning left ahead (C) can allow passing on the right while staying on the roadway. Neither permits using the shoulder, so B applies.
延伸考点　在双向两车道公路上，自己一侧是允许超车的虚黄线、前方视野清楚、没有迫近的对向车、能够在限速内完成并安全并回时，可以从左侧超车。自己一侧是禁止超车的实黄线，或弯道、坡顶挡住视线时，就应等待。单行道、同向有多条车道的公路，或前车正在左转时，可以在有足够空间且安全的情况下从右侧超车。举例：前车等左转，右边有可用的行车道，可以从该车道通过；右边只有路肩，即使铺了沥青也要等。

On a two-lane highway, you may pass on the left when the broken yellow line is on your side, the view is clear, and you have room to complete the pass within the speed limit and return safely before oncoming traffic reaches you. Wait if a solid yellow line on your side prohibits passing or a hill or curve blocks your view. Passing on the right can be lawful on a one-way street, on a highway with multiple lanes in your direction, or when the vehicle ahead is turning left, provided there is room to pass safely on the roadway. If a car is waiting to turn left, an available traffic lane on its right may be used. A shoulder, even a paved one, may not. DMV 官方资料

zh: 當鐵路平交道不受控制，而您在 100 呎範圍內，兩個方向的能見度不到 400 呎時，車速限制是多少？
en: When a railroad crossing is not controlled, what is the speed limit when you are within 100 feet and cannot see for 400 feet in both directions?
notes: 题意与解析　接近没有控制设施且视线受阻的铁路平交道时要预留停车距离。题设是在距道口 100 英尺内看不清沿铁轨 400 英尺的情况，限速为每小时 15 英里。
At an uncontrolled railroad crossing with the restricted view described here, the limit within 100 feet of the crossing is 15 mph. Leave enough distance to stop.
延伸考点　100 英尺是你的车到道口的距离，400 英尺是沿铁轨观察火车的视距。换一种题设：如果道口红灯闪烁，或栏杆正在放下，就必须停车；以 15 mph 慢行也不能通过。

The 100 feet measures your distance from the crossing. The 400 feet measures how far you can see along the tracks. If red lights are flashing or a gate is coming down, stop. Slowing to 15 mph does not authorize you to cross. DMV 官方资料

zh: 以下哪一項是平行泊車的正確程序？
en: Which of the following is the proper procedure for parallel parking?
options: 在開放空間前方車輛旁邊停車，然後駛回泊車位。
Stop next to the vehicle in front of the open space, and then back into the space.
在開放空間後方車輛旁邊停車，然後向前駛回泊車位。
Stop next to the vehicle behind the open space, and then drive forward into the space.
無需停車而駛入泊車位。
Drive forward into the space without stopping.
notes: 题意与解析　本站按 DMV 英文官网和驾驶员手册计分，选 A。 打转向灯，与空位前方的车辆并排停下，检查后视镜和盲区，再缓慢倒入车位。中文网页却把 C 判为正确。DMV 手册的平行停车步骤

The English DMV quiz and handbook agree: stop beside the vehicle ahead of the space, check mirrors and blind spots, then back in slowly. This is option A here. The Chinese DMV quiz marks a different maneuver as correct.
延伸考点　判断两个动作的先后：先在车位前方车辆旁停稳，才能检查后方是否有人或车，再倒入。选项 B 把参照车辆换成了后车，C 跳过了停车观察。停好后，车身应与路缘平行，靠路缘一侧的车轮距路缘不超过 18 英寸。

First stop beside the vehicle ahead of the space so you can check behind you before reversing. B puts you beside the wrong vehicle. C skips the stop and safety check. Finish parallel to the curb with the curbside wheels within 18 inches of it. DMV 官方资料

zh: 進入高速公路時，應以什麼速度行駛？
en: What speed should you be driving when entering onto a highway?
options: At or near the speed of traffic.
Faster than the speed of traffic.
Slower than the speed of traffic.
notes: 题意与解析　利用匝道调整车速，在安全、合法的范围内接近主路车流速度，再找空隙并入。已经在高速公路上的车辆有优先权。
Use the ramp to approach the speed of highway traffic when safe and legal. Yield to traffic already on the highway and merge into a safe gap.
延伸考点　例如主路车流因拥堵只有 35 mph，即使限速牌写着 65，也应按眼前车流找空隙。打灯并回头看盲区；车流速度相近并不会让主路车辆负有让你先并入的义务。

If congestion has slowed freeway traffic to 35 mph on a road posted at 65, match the actual flow as you look for a gap. Signal and check your blind spot. Matching speed does not give you priority over traffic already on the freeway. DMV 官方资料

zh: 當接近向您駛來的車輛時，應在多少呎距離以外將車頭燈由遠光燈轉為近光燈？
en: How many feet away should you switch from high beam to low beam headlights when approaching a vehicle coming towards you?
notes: 题意与解析　与对向来车相距 500 英尺以内时使用近光灯，避免远光让对方短暂看不清道路。
Within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle, switch to low beams to avoid dazzling the other driver.
延伸考点　题目中的 coming towards you 是“迎面驶来”。同向跟车考另一个数字：跟在前车后方 300 英尺以内也要切近光，避免远光经前车后视镜照进驾驶员眼睛。
“Coming towards you” means oncoming traffic. When following another vehicle, the distance is 300 feet: dim your high beams to avoid glare in the other driver’s mirrors. DMV 官方资料

zh: 誰人可在道路邊緣旁邊塗有藍色的區域合法泊車？
en: Who can legally park next to curb painted blue?
options: 在該地點安排上落客之人士。
Someone who is either picking up or dropping off passengers at this location.
持有殘障人士特殊標語或車牌的人士。
A person who is disabled and has a special placard or vehicle license plate for disabled persons.
僅在道路邊緣泊車不超過 15 分鐘之人士。
A person who will only be parked at the curb for less than 15 minutes.
notes: 题意与解析　蓝色路缘是残障专用停车区。具备有效残障停车牌或专用车牌、且为符合资格者本人出行服务时才可使用。
A blue curb is reserved for disabled parking. Use it only with a valid disabled parking placard or plate when transporting the eligible person or when that person is driving.
延伸考点　例如你载着持证人去医院并为其停车，可以按资格使用；仅因车内放着家人的停车牌，独自办事时不能使用。蓝色车位旁的斜线区要留给人和轮椅升降设备，即使持牌也不能停。

You may use the space when transporting the permit holder for their trip. Having a relative’s placard in the car does not qualify you on a trip alone. Even a placard holder must leave the striped access aisle clear. DMV 官方资料

zh: 前方有校巴開始閃動黃色警告訊號燈時，應如何處理？
en: What should you do when there is a school bus ahead that starts flashing yellow warning lights?
options: Slow down and prepare to stop.
立即停車並保持停車狀態。
Cautiously pass the school bus on the left.
notes: 题意与解析　校车闪黄灯表示即将停车让学生上下车。此时先减速，并做好停车准备。
Flashing yellow lights mean the school bus is preparing to stop for students. Slow down and be ready to stop.
延伸考点　换成闪红灯时，须按规定停车，直到红灯停止闪烁。注意方向：校车在分隔公路另一侧，或在每方向至少两条车道的多车道公路另一侧时，反向来车适用手册所列例外。

Flashing red lights require affected drivers to stop until the lights stop flashing. The handbook gives an exception for opposing traffic when the bus is across a divided highway or a multilane highway with at least two lanes in each direction. DMV 官方资料

zh: 以下哪一項是《加州基本行車速度法》的要求？
en: Which of the following is a requirement of California’s Basic Speed Law?
options: 無論條件如何，務必依照速度限制行駛。
Always drive the speed limit, regardless of conditions.
讓您的速度與周圍車流速度相符。
Match your speed to that of your surrounding traffic.
切勿以超出現有安全狀況的車速行駛。
Never drive faster than is safe for current conditions.
notes: 题意与解析　即使低于标示限速，车速对当前天气、视距或路面状况来说仍可能过快。应选择能安全控制车辆的速度。
Even below the posted limit, your speed may be unsafe for the weather, visibility, or road surface. Choose a speed at which you can control the vehicle.
延伸考点　例如限速 55 mph，浓雾中要到很近才看见前车，此时开 55 仍可能过快。反过来，天气晴朗也不能因为旁车都开 70 就超过标示上限。

On a road posted at 55 mph, dense fog may make 55 unsafe because you cannot see a stopped vehicle in time. Conversely, clear weather and nearby drivers doing 70 do not authorize you to exceed the posted limit. DMV 官方资料

zh: 倘若有以下情況，您須在 5 日內通知 DMV：
en: You must notify the DMV with 5 days, if you:
options: 出售或轉讓您車輛的所有權。
Sell or transfer ownership of your vehicle.
為您的車輛塗上不同顏色。
Paint your vehicle a different color.
notes: 题意与解析　卖车或转让所有权后，原车主须在 5 天内通知 DMV，以便记录车辆转让。
After selling a vehicle or transferring ownership, the former owner must notify DMV within five days so the transfer can be recorded.
延伸考点　记住是谁、报什么：是卖方在出售或转让后提交车辆转让及免责通知（NRL）。这用来记录车辆何时转手；收到罚单或给车换颜色都不会触发本题所说的五天转让通知。

Identify who files and why: the seller files a Notice of Transfer and Release of Liability (NRL) after the sale or transfer. It records when the vehicle changed hands. A ticket or repainting the car does not trigger that five-day transfer notice. DMV 官方资料

zh: 以下哪一項為安全駕駛慣例的事例？
en: Which of the following is an example of a safe driving practice?
options: Staring only at the middle of the road.
雙眼始終細看周圍環境。
Always keep your eyes moving to scan the surroundings.
在大霧中使用遠光車頭燈。
Using your high-beam headlights in the fog
notes: 题意与解析　持续扫视前方、两侧和后视镜，能提早发现行人、并线车辆和其他危险。
Scan ahead, to both sides, and in your mirrors to spot pedestrians, merging vehicles, and hazards early.
延伸考点　例如准备并线时，先扫视前方，再看后视镜、打灯，并在横向移动前回头确认盲区。只看道路中央会漏掉侧方车辆；只看镜子也可能漏掉与你并行的摩托车。

Before changing lanes, scan ahead, use your mirrors, signal, and look over your shoulder before moving sideways. Staring straight ahead misses traffic beside you. Mirrors alone can miss a motorcycle riding alongside. DMV 官方资料

zh: 在有乘坐電動輪椅的人進入人行道的十字路口時，該怎麼辦？
en: What should you do when reaching an intersection where a person operating a motorized wheelchair has entered the crosswalk?
options: 在行人穿越道線一直停留，直至使用電動輪椅人士安全通過馬路。
Remain stopped behind the crosswalk line until the motorized wheelchair has safely finished crossing.
如使用電動輪椅人士在行人穿越道線附停留，請行使您的先行權。
Assume right-of-way if the motorized wheelchair stops in the crosswalk.
在行人穿越道線附近一直停留，直至使用電動輪椅人士遠離您的行車範圍。
Remain stopped behind the nearest crosswalk line until the motorized wheelchair is beyond the range of your vehicle.
notes: 题意与解析　使用电动轮椅的人过街时享有行人的通行权。按本题，应停在人行横道线后，等对方安全过完马路。
A person crossing in a motorized wheelchair has pedestrian right-of-way. Stop behind the crosswalk and wait until the person has safely finished crossing.
延伸考点　人在横道中央稍作停顿，也不等于把通行权让给你。应把车停在横道线后，留出对方继续前行的空间；不要抢先从轮椅前方穿过。
A pause in the crosswalk does not mean the person is giving up the right-of-way. Stay behind the line, leave room for them to continue, and do not cut across in front of the wheelchair. DMV 官方资料

zh: 關於大型商用載貨車，以下哪一項為正確？
en: Which of the following is true about large trucks?
options: 這列車由許多拖車製成，使其與載客用車相較更容易操作。
They are made of many trailers, which make them more maneuverable than passenger vehicles.
他們有大盲點，這使得運貨卡車駕駛員難以看到其他車輛。
They have large blind spots, which makes it difficult for the truck driver to see other vehicles.
他們有大而強的緊急煞車，這使他們能夠快速停車。
They have large and powerful emergency brakes, which gives them the capability to stop quickly.
notes: 题意与解析　大型货车的前后方和两侧都有较大盲区。长时间并排行驶，会让货车司机难以判断你的位置。
Large trucks have large blind spots on both sides and to the front and rear. If you stay alongside a truck, its driver can lose track of you.
延伸考点　如果你在货车后面，连它的侧后视镜都看不到，应预期司机也看不到你。需要超过时，在安全、合法的车道完成超车并留出距离再并回；大型货车需要更长的停车距离。

If you are behind a truck and cannot see its side mirrors, assume its driver cannot see you. Use a lawful lane to pass safely and leave room before merging back. Trucks need more stopping distance. DMV 官方资料

zh: 以下哪一項是撞車事故的最常見原因之一？
en: What is one of the most common causes of traffic collisions?
notes: 题意与解析　分心会占用观察和反应的时间。低头看手机的几秒内，前车就可能已开始刹车。
Distractions leave less time to notice hazards and react. The car ahead can start braking during a brief glance at your phone.
延伸考点　分心包括眼离路面、手离方向盘，以及注意力转到别处。即使手机固定在支架上，低头输入目的地仍会漏看前车刹车；可在出发前设置，或安全停好再操作。

Distraction can take your eyes off the road, hands off the wheel, or attention away from driving. Typing a destination into a mounted phone can still make you miss brake lights. Set it before leaving or after parking safely. DMV 官方资料

zh: 故意逃逸或試圖逃避執法，並在逃避過程中引致他人嚴重受傷，將受以下處罰：
en: Any driver who willfully flees or attempts to evade law enforcement, during which a person is seriously injured, is subject to:
options: 在國家監獄監禁長達七年。
Imprisonment in a state prison for up to seven years.
notes: 题意与解析　题目限定为故意逃避执法并造成他人重伤。所列选项中，最高可判七年监禁；“最高”指可能的刑期上限。
The question specifies deliberate evasion resulting in serious injury. Of the listed penalties, imprisonment for up to seven years applies. Seven years is the maximum possible term.
延伸考点　这题的七年是针对故意逃避且造成重伤的最高刑期，不能套到所有被警察示意停车的情况。看到警车示意你停车时，应打转向灯，在安全地点靠右停下。

The seven-year maximum in the question depends on deliberate evasion causing serious injury. It does not apply to every traffic stop. When an officer signals you to pull over, signal and stop safely on the right. DMV 官方资料

zh: 在交叉路口停下並想要左轉的駕駛員，應採取什麼行動？
en: What should a driver do who is stopped at an intersection and wants to make a left turn?
options: 倘若沒有行人，請立即轉彎。
Turn immediately if there are no pedestrians.
在迎面而來的車流前讓行轉彎。
Take the right-of-way turn before oncoming traffic.
向距離過近而有危險的正在接近的車輛予以讓行。
Give the right-of-way to any approaching vehicle that is close enough to be dangerous.
notes: 题意与解析　左转会横穿对向车流。先让距离近到可能发生冲突的来车通过，再利用足够大的空隙转弯。
A left turn crosses oncoming traffic. Yield to approaching vehicles close enough to pose a hazard, then turn when there is a safe gap.
延伸考点　对向车打了右转灯，也可能准备在下一个路口才转。不要仅凭灯号从它前面左转；等它开始转弯，确认路线和空隙，再检查横道上的行人。

An oncoming driver signaling right may intend to turn at the next intersection. Wait until the vehicle begins its turn, confirm there is a safe gap, and check the crosswalk before turning left. DMV 官方资料

zh: 除了設定泊車制動外，在山坡上泊車時應如何處理？
en: In addition to setting your parking brake, what should you do when parking on a hill?
options: 確認您的車輛處於「空檔」位置。
Make sure your vehicle is left in the “neutral” position.
確認車輛前輪與路面平行。
Make sure the front vehicle wheels are parallel to the road.
確認您的車輛位於「泊車」位置或檔位。
Make sure your vehicle is in the “park” position or in gear.
notes: 题意与解析　在坡上停车，除拉好驻车制动，还要让自动挡处于 P 挡，手动挡挂入挡位，以降低溜车风险。
Set the parking brake and leave an automatic transmission in Park or a manual transmission in gear to reduce the risk of rolling.
延伸考点　挡位之外还要看坡向：有路缘时，下坡停车前轮朝向路缘，上坡停车前轮背向路缘；没有路缘时，前轮朝道路右侧，让意外滑动的车远离车流。

Wheel direction matters too. With a curb, turn the front wheels toward it when facing downhill and away from it when facing uphill. Without a curb, turn the wheels toward the right side of the road so a rolling vehicle moves away from traffic. DMV 官方资料

zh: 您未滿 18 歲，並已持有自己的執照八個月。您可以駕駛：
en: You are under 18 years of age and have had your license for eight months. You may drive:
options: 清晨 5 時正至夜晚 11 時正之間。
早晨 7 時正至夜晚 8 時正之間。
notes: 题意与解析　未满 18 岁且持临时驾照的头 12 个月，通常不得在晚上 11 点至次日清晨 5 点独自驾驶。本题没有给出例外条件。
During the first 12 months of a provisional license, drivers under 18 generally cannot drive alone from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. The question gives no exception.
延伸考点　持证八个月仍在最初十二个月内。若有符合规定的持照家长、监护人或年满 25 岁的加州持照驾驶员随车，夜间限制的适用情形就不同。题目没有给出陪同条件。

Eight months is still within the first twelve. The nighttime restriction has an exception when accompanied by a qualifying licensed parent or guardian or a California-licensed driver aged 25 or older. The question gives no such condition. DMV 官方资料

zh: 從一條單程街道左轉轉入另一條單程街道，應該從哪裏開始？
en: Where should you begin a left turn from a one-way street onto a one-way street?
options: 最靠近街道中心的行車線。
The lane closest to the center of the street.
您可從任何行車線轉彎。
You can turn from any lane.
notes: 题意与解析　两条路都是单行道时，通常从原道路最左侧车道开始左转，避免横切同向车流。
For a left turn from one one-way street onto another, normally start in the far-left lane to avoid cutting across traffic.
延伸考点　看题干问的是从哪里开始转。若从双向街左转，通常靠近本方向道路中心线准备；从单行街左转，左边没有对向车道，通常靠最左侧准备。有转向箭头时按标线行驶。

The question asks where to start. On a two-way street, normally prepare near the center line on your side. On a one-way street, normally prepare at the far left. Follow any marked turn arrows. DMV 官方资料

zh: 在下列情況，您須提交在加州 (SR-1) 交通意外報告，以通知 DMV：
en: You are required to notify DMV by filing a Report of Traffic Accident Occuring in California (SR-1) form if:
options: You failed to pay your registration fees.
您涉及一項損失超過 $1,000 的撞車事故。
You were involved in a collision with more than $1,000 in damages.
您允許來自其他州持牌的駕駛員駕駛您的車輛。
You allowed a licensed driver from another state to drive your vehicle.
notes: 题意与解析　事故造成任何一人的财产损失超过 1,000 美元，就触发 SR-1 报告要求。应在 10 天内向 DMV 提交。
File an SR-1 with DMV within 10 days if the collision causes more than $1,000 in damage to any one person’s property.
延伸考点　例如只撞坏停放车辆、无人受伤，但给该车造成 1,200 美元损失，仍须报告。若有人受伤，则另有独立的报告条件，不必先达到 1,000 美元财损。

If you cause $1,200 in damage to a parked car and nobody is hurt, the reporting requirement still applies. Injury is a separate trigger and does not depend on reaching the property-damage threshold. DMV 官方资料

zh: 在天氣酷熱的日子下雨時，道路什麼時候會比較濕滑？
en: At what point during a rainfall are roads slippery on a hot day?
options: When it has been raining for a few hours.
Immediately after it has stopped raining.
notes: 题意与解析　雨刚落下时，积在路面的油污和灰尘与水混合，轮胎抓地力会下降。
When rain begins, water mixes with oil and dust on the pavement, reducing tire traction.
延伸考点　热天久未下雨时，初雨把积油、灰尘和水混在一起。此时提早减速、加大跟车距离，并轻柔转向和制动；不能因为雨刚开始、积水还浅就按干路速度过弯。
After a hot, dry spell, the first rain mixes with accumulated oil and dust. Slow before curves, increase following distance, and steer and brake gently, even before standing water develops. DMV 官方资料

zh: 什麼顏色的道路邊緣不允許車輛停車或泊車？
en: What color curb does not allow vehicles to stop or park?
notes: 题意与解析　对普通车辆，红色路缘表示禁止停车、停留或泊车；短暂停下接人也不可以。
For ordinary vehicles, a red curb prohibits stopping, standing, or parking, even briefly to pick someone up.
延伸考点　想让乘客下车时，普通车仍不能临停在红色路缘。白色路缘通常允许短暂停靠上下客；黄色路缘则依标志限时上下客或装卸货物。

An ordinary vehicle cannot stop at a red curb to drop off a passenger. A white curb generally permits brief passenger pickup or drop-off. A yellow curb allows loading or unloading subject to posted limits. DMV 官方资料

zh: 在下列情況，您須提交在加州 (SR-1) 交通意外報告，以通知 DMV：
en: You are required to notify DMV by filing a Report of Traffic Accident Occuring in California (SR-1) form if:
options: 您的車輛未通過廢氣測試。
Your vehicle fails a smog test.
您涉及一項出現人員受傷的撞車事故。
You were involved in a collision with an injury.
notes: 题意与解析　只要有人受伤，即使伤势轻或财损很小，也须在 10 天内向 DMV 提交 SR-1。
If anyone is injured, file an SR-1 with DMV within 10 days, even when the injury is minor or property damage is slight.
延伸考点　例如骑车人擦伤，车辆没有明显损坏，也符合人员受伤的报告条件。向保险公司报案或警方到场，都不能代替当事人按要求向 DMV 提交 SR-1。
A cyclist’s minor injury triggers reporting even if the vehicle shows no damage. An insurance claim or police response does not replace the required SR-1 filing with DMV. DMV 官方资料

zh: 兩組相隔 2 呎或以上的雙黃線表示什麼？
en: What is indicated by two sets of double yellow lines spaced 2 feet or more apart?
options: 合用車專用道/高載客量車輛(HOV)專用道。
在同一方向移動的車流的行車線。
Lanes of traffic moving in the same direction.
notes: 题意与解析　两组双黄线相隔至少 2 英尺，相当于中央隔离带。需要左转或掉头时，应寻找指定开口。
Two sets of double yellow lines at least two feet apart form a barrier. Look for a designated opening to turn left or make a U-turn.
延伸考点　一道双实黄线与相隔至少两英尺的两组双黄线规则不同：在允许左转进入车道入口时可以跨越前者；两组构成隔离带时，应到指定开口再转，不能直接穿过。
A single pair of solid yellow lines may be crossed for a permitted left turn into a driveway. Two pairs at least two feet apart form a barrier. Use a designated opening to turn across it. DMV 官方资料

zh: 要在下一個交叉路口右轉，應如何處理？
en: What should you do to make a right turn at an upcoming intersection?
options: 轉彎前，請先併入腳踏車行車線。
Merge into the bicycle lane before making the turn.
到達腳踏車行車線終點，然後轉彎。
Wait until the bicycle lane ends, then make the turn.
從目前的行車線轉彎，切勿進入腳踏車行車線。
Make the turn from your current lane and do not enter the bicycle lane.
notes: 题意与解析　右转前先看右侧盲区，礼让骑车人。在允许并入的普通自行车道，距转弯处 200 英尺以内、安全时再并入，避免从骑车人左侧横切其路线。DMV 手册
Check your right blind spot and yield to cyclists. Where permitted, merge safely into the bike lane within 200 feet of the turn to avoid cutting across a cyclist’s path.
延伸考点　如果一辆自行车正在你右后方直行，先让它经过，再从后方安全并入。不能为了抢先转弯，从它左边突然横切；也不能提前数个街口把自行车道当作右转排队车道。

If a cyclist is riding straight just behind you on the right, let them pass, then merge safely behind. Do not turn across their path or use the bike lane as a queue several blocks before the turn. DMV 官方资料

zh: 高速公路已列明車速限制為時速 65英哩。這個是什麼意思？
en: A highway has a posted speed limit of 65 mph. What does this mean?
options: 您可在沒有其他車輛的情況下加快速度行駛。
You may drive faster only if there are no other vehicles.
您須在該高速公路上以時速 65 英哩的車速行駛。
You must always drive 65 mph on that highway.
您須在駕駛條件理想的情況下以 時速65 英哩的車速行駛。
You must drive 65 mph only if driving conditions are ideal.
notes: 题意与解析　网页判 C。理解为理想条件下最高每小时 65 英里；遇雨雾、拥堵等情况要降低车速。限速牌没有要求司机必须开到 65。
The quiz accepts C. Treat 65 mph as the maximum in ideal conditions. Slow down for rain, fog, or congestion. The sign does not require you to reach 65 mph.
延伸考点　看见 maximum 或 posted limit，先理解为上限。晴天、空路也不能因此超过 65；如果前方车流停滞、视线受阻或路面湿滑，还要把速度降到能安全控制的水平。

Read a posted maximum as a ceiling. Clear skies or an empty road do not permit more than 65. Stopped traffic, limited visibility, or a slippery surface may require a substantially lower speed. DMV 官方资料

zh: 什麼時候允許在交叉線（對角線）區域泊車？
en: When is parking in a crosshatched (diagonal lines) area allowed?
options: 不許在交叉線（對角線）區域內泊車。
It is never allowed to park in a crosshatched (diagonal lines) area.
該區域被標為腳踏車行車線（另有標示者除外）。
If the area is labeled as a bicycle lane, unless otherwise posted.
倘若該區域距離鐵路軌道至少二十呎。
If the area is at least twenty feet away from a railroad track.
notes: 题意与解析　斜线区用来留出通行或操作空间，例如为轮椅升降设备预留空间。应保持畅通。
Diagonal hatching reserves space for access or maneuvering, such as room for a wheelchair lift. Keep it clear.
延伸考点　例如两个残障车位之间的斜线区，看似够停一辆摩托车，实际上是供人通行、展开轮椅坡道的空间。即使只停几分钟，或驾驶员持有残障停车牌，也不能占用。

The stripes between accessible spaces may look wide enough for a motorcycle, but they provide access and room to deploy a ramp. A short stay or a disabled placard does not authorize parking there. DMV 官方资料

zh: 倘若您的手機有來電，而沒有免提裝置，應如何處理？
en: What should you do if your cell phone rings and you do not have a hands-free device?
options: 接聽電話，讓通話盡可能簡短。
Answer the call and keep the conversation short.
切勿接聽電話，讓其轉至留言信箱。
Do not answer the phone and let it go to voice mail.
在紅燈停車時，請接聽電話。
Answer the call if you are stopped at a red light.
notes: 题意与解析　普通来电可转入语音信箱，待安全合法地停好车后再回拨。路口等红灯时仍处于驾驶中。
Let an ordinary call go to voicemail and return it after parking safely and legally. Waiting at a red light still counts as driving.
延伸考点　“等红灯”与“安全合法地停好车”不同：前者仍在行车道中，本题的普通来电应交给语音信箱。遇到需要联系紧急服务的紧急情况，另有例外。

Waiting at a red light leaves you in traffic. For the routine call in this question, use voicemail until safely parked. A genuine emergency requiring an emergency-service call is a separate exception. DMV 官方资料

zh: 倘若交通訊號為綠色，但交叉路口出現交通阻塞，應如何處理？
en: If a traffic signal is green, but traffic is blocking the intersection, what should you do?
options: 倘若交通狀況許可，請部分進入交叉路口。
Partially enter the intersection, as allowed by traffic.
等候，切勿進入交叉路口，直至您的車輛完全通過。
Wait and do not enter the intersection until your vehicle can get completely across.
跟隨路肩的車流行駛，以協助緩解擁擠。
Drive around the traffic on the shoulder to help ease the congestion.
notes: 题意与解析　先确认路口另一端有足够空间容纳整辆车。如果驶入后会堵在人行横道或路口中央，即使绿灯也应等候。
Make sure there is room for your whole vehicle beyond the intersection. Even on green, wait if you would end up blocking the crosswalk or intersection.
延伸考点　例如前车刚起步，但路口对面只有半个车身的空位。即使绿灯且后车催促，仍应停在线后；等出口能容下整辆车、横道也畅通时再进入。

If the car ahead moves but only half a car length is free beyond the intersection, wait behind the line even on green. Enter once the exit can hold your entire vehicle and the crosswalk is clear. DMV 官方资料

zh: 右轉時，您應該在哪條行車線結束轉彎？
en: In which lane should you end your turn when making a right turn?
options: 最接近道路左側路肩的行車線。
The lane closest to the left edge of the road.
任何沒有車流的行車線。
最接近道路右側路肩的行車線。
The lane closest to the right edge of the road.
notes: 题意与解析　普通单一右转车道通常转入最靠右的车道。若有多条转弯车道或引导线，应跟随本车道标线完成转弯。
From a single right-turn lane, normally finish in the rightmost lane. Where there are multiple turn lanes or guide lines, follow your lane markings.
延伸考点　转进右侧车道后，若确实需要去左侧车道，应先完成转弯，再看镜子、打灯、检查盲区后变道。直接大幅甩进左车道容易与其他转弯车辆交叉。

If you need a lane farther left, finish the right turn first, then signal, check mirrors and blind spots, and change lanes safely. Swinging wide during the turn can put you across another turning vehicle’s path. DMV 官方资料

zh: 什麼時候需聽從交通協管員的指示？
en: When is it required for you to obey directions from a crossing guard?
options: 僅限孩子在學校門口時。
Only when children are present in front of a school.
notes: 题意与解析　遇到正在指挥交通的协管员，应听从指示。周围是否有学生、是否上课时间，都不改变这项要求。
Obey a crossing guard who is directing traffic, regardless of school hours or whether students are visible.
延伸考点　协管员举停牌时，即使信号灯是绿灯、你也没有看见孩子，仍须停下。先服从现场指挥，并在获准且横道安全后再通行。
When the crossing guard holds up a stop sign, stop even if the light is green and no child is visible. Proceed when directed and when the crosswalk is safe. DMV 官方资料

zh: 關於大型商用載貨車，以下哪一項為正確？
en: Which of the following is true about large trucks?
options: 這列車由許多拖車製成，使其與載客用車相較更容易操作。
They are made of many trailers, which make them more maneuverable than passenger vehicles.
他們有大盲點，這使得運貨卡車駕駛員難以看到其他車輛。
They have large blind spots, which makes it difficult for the truck driver to see other vehicles.
他們有大而強的緊急煞車，這使他們能夠快速停車。
They have large and powerful emergency brakes, which gives them the capability to stop quickly.
notes: 题意与解析　即使你的车与货车并排，你能看见货车，也不代表货车司机能看见你；应避免停留在它的盲区。
Even if you can see a truck alongside you, its driver may be unable to see you. Avoid lingering in its blind spots.
延伸考点　另一种危险是超完车立刻并到货车车头前：货车近前方也有盲区，停车还需要更多空间。等能在车内后视镜中看见整辆货车的车头，再安全并回。

Cutting in immediately after passing is dangerous because a truck has a front blind spot and needs room to stop. Wait until you can see its entire front in your rearview mirror before merging back safely. DMV 官方资料

zh: 駕駛時，以下哪一項屬於違法？
en: Which of the following is illegal while driving?
options: 戴上可覆蓋雙耳的耳機或耳塞。
Wearing a headset or ear plugs that covers both ears.
戴上可覆蓋單耳的耳機或耳塞。
Wearing a headset or ear plugs that covers one ear.
在住宅區街道上使用巡航控制。
Using cruise control on residential streets.
notes: 题意与解析　一般驾驶时双耳都被耳机或耳塞覆盖，会妨碍听见警笛、喇叭等警示声。
Covering both ears with headphones or earplugs while driving can keep you from hearing sirens, horns, and other warnings.
延伸考点　题目用 both ears 限定了双耳。只覆盖一耳的选项没有满足这项禁令的条件；但若同时手持手机通话，仍要另行判断手机使用规则。
The words “both ears” define the restriction tested here. Covering one ear does not meet that condition. Holding a phone while using a single earpiece raises a separate phone-use issue. DMV 官方资料

zh: 在交通繁忙之時，您須越過鐵路路軌方可到達下一個交叉路口，應如何處理？
en: What should you do when traffic is slow and heavy, and you must cross railroad tracks before reaching the upcoming intersection?
options: 當您前方的車輛穿過軌道時開始過馬路。
Begin crossing when the vehicle in front of you is crossing the tracks.
在軌道上等待，直到交叉路口的停車燈號變為綠色。
Wait on the tracks until the stoplight at the intersection turns green.
等待完全穿過軌道，然後繼續前行。
Wait until you can completely cross the tracks before proceeding.
notes: 题意与解析　等到铁轨对面有空间容纳整辆车再驶入。仅看见前车开始移动，不能保证自己的车尾也能离开铁轨。
Wait until there is room beyond the tracks for your entire vehicle. The car ahead starting to move does not guarantee your rear bumper will clear the tracks.
延伸考点　即使道口栏杆竖着、警示灯没亮，前方堵车也可能把你困在铁轨上。进入前看出口，不跟着前车盲目起步；有多股铁轨时，出口要能让车尾越过最后一股。

Even with the gate up and the lights off, a queue can trap you on the tracks. Check the exit before following the vehicle ahead. At a multitrack crossing, the rear of your vehicle must clear the last track. DMV 官方资料

zh: 倘若您被其他車輛尾隨，應採取以下哪一項措施？
en: Which of the following should you do if you are being followed by a tailgater?
options: 改變行車線，讓後方尾隨的車輛通過。
Change lanes and allow the tailgater to pass.
輕觸煞車以發出您正在以較慢速度行駛的訊號。
Tap the brakes to signal you are moving at a slower pace.
加快您的速度，以協調車輛速度。
Increase your speed to match the speed of the vehicle.
notes: 题意与解析　被后车紧跟时，保持操作平稳，并在安全时变道让它通过。突然点刹可能增加追尾风险。
If someone follows too closely, drive smoothly and change lanes when safe to let them pass. Tapping the brakes can increase the risk of a rear-end collision.
延伸考点　如果一时没有安全的变道空隙，先增加自己与前车的距离，给自己留出渐进制动的余地。等到能安全变道再让后车通过，避免用点刹警告对方。
If you cannot safely change lanes yet, increase the gap ahead so you have room to brake gradually. Let the tailgater pass when safe and avoid tapping your brakes as a warning. DMV 官方资料

zh: 當您以限制車速行駛時，您或會被發出超速吿票：
en: When you are driving the speed limit, you can be given a speeding ticket:
options: 倘若道路狀況或天氣條件需要減慢速度。
If road or weather conditions require a slower speed.
這在任何情況下始終屬於合法。
Under no circumstances because it is always legal.
只有當您正在接近道路上彎曲位時。
Only if you are approaching a sharp curve in the road.
notes: 题意与解析　下雨、起雾或路面湿滑时，即使速度等于标示限速，仍可能超过当时的安全速度而被开罚单。
In rain or fog, or on a slippery road, the posted limit may be too fast for conditions. You can receive a speeding ticket even at that speed.
延伸考点　区分两种情形：天气良好时，标示限速仍是上限；能见度或抓地力变差时，实际安全速度可能更低。因此“我正好开到限速”不能单独证明车速安全。
In good weather the posted limit remains a ceiling. Poor visibility or traction can lower the safe speed. Matching the number on the sign alone does not establish that the speed was safe. DMV 官方资料

zh: 駕駛員因塵土或煙霧吹過道路而無法看見其他車輛，應使用哪些燈光？
en: Which lights should be used if a driver is having trouble seeing other vehicles because of dust or smoke blowing across the roadway?
notes: 题意与解析　开启前照灯，使用近光。近光有助于其他人看见你，也能减少灰尘或烟雾中的反射眩光。
Turn on your low-beam headlights. They help others see you and reduce glare from light reflected by dust or smoke.
延伸考点　选项只写 headlights，实际操作用近光。远光会让烟尘反射更多光，反而更难看清；仅开停车灯不能替代前照灯。若看不清前方，应同时降低车速。
The option says “headlights.” Use low beams: high beams reflect more light off airborne particles, and parking lights do not substitute for headlights. Reduce speed as visibility falls. DMV 官方资料

zh: 要在下一個交叉路口右轉，應如何處理？
en: What should you do to make a right turn at an upcoming intersection?
options: 到達腳踏車行車線終點，然後轉彎。
Wait until the bicycle lane ends, then make the turn.
從目前的行車線轉彎，切勿進入腳踏車行車線。
Make the turn from your current lane and do not enter the bicycle lane.
轉彎前，請先併入腳踏車行車線。
Merge into the bicycle lane before making the turn.
notes: 题意与解析　先礼让自行车，查看右后方，在距转弯处 200 英尺以内安全并入普通自行车道，再右转。这与第三套第 4 题考的是同一规则，但选项顺序不同。

Yield to cyclists and check behind you on the right. When safe, merge into the conventional bike lane within 200 feet of the turn, then turn right. Test 3, question 4 covers the same rule with a different option order.
延伸考点　观察自行车道的类型和标线。本题指可依法并入的普通自行车道；若有实体隔离或专门的转弯引导标线，就按路口设计转弯，不能跨越实体隔离。

Check the markings and layout. The question assumes a conventional bike lane that motorists may legally enter for a turn. At a protected lane or a separately marked turn, follow the intersection design and do not cross a physical barrier. DMV 官方资料

zh: 閃爍的黃色交通信號燈指示司機採取什麼措施？
en: What does a flashing yellow traffic signal light direct a driver to do?
options: 當交通狀況可讓您安全前進時，停車並繼續下一步。
Stop and proceed when the traffic allows you to proceed safely.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
停下來並等待綠色信號燈亮起。
Stop and wait for a flashing green signal.
notes: 题意与解析　闪烁黄灯提示前方有潜在危险。减速观察，确认安全后谨慎通过。
A flashing yellow light warns of a possible hazard. Slow down, look for conflicts, and proceed cautiously when safe.
延伸考点　闪黄灯可以在确认安全后谨慎通过；换成闪红灯，就要像遇到 STOP 标志一样先完全停稳，按先行权规则让行后再走。关键是同时看颜色和是否闪烁。
At flashing yellow, proceed cautiously when safe. At flashing red, first come to a full stop as at a stop sign, yield as required, then proceed. Both color and flashing pattern matter. DMV 官方资料

zh: 當「禁止行走 (DON'T WALK)」標誌開始閃爍後，行人穿越道上仍有行人，應如何處理？
en: What should you do if a pedestrian is still in the crosswalk after the “DON”T WALK” sign begins to flash and your light has turned green?
options: 等待行人訊號，確認情況良好然後繼續。
Wait until the pedestrian signals that it is okay for you to proceed.
等待行人離開您所在的路徑，然後繼續。
Wait until the pedestrian is out of your path before proceeding.
等待行人全部過馬路，然後繼續。
Wait until the pedestrian has crossed the street completely before proceeding.
notes: 题意与解析　即使车辆信号已变绿，驾驶员仍须让行。闪烁的禁止行走信号提醒尚未进入横道的人暂缓起步；已经在横道中的行人仍可过街。中文网页判 C，等待行人全部过完马路。
A flashing DON'T WALK signal tells people who have not entered the crosswalk to wait. Those already crossing may finish. The Chinese quiz accepts C: wait until the pedestrian has crossed completely.
延伸考点　英文原题还给了一个条件：你这边已经变绿灯。绿灯不能取消横道上行人的优先通行权；也不能用行人灯开始闪烁来催促已经在横道中的人。

The English question adds that your light has turned green. That does not take priority over a pedestrian already crossing. The flashing pedestrian signal is no reason to rush someone who is still in the crosswalk. DMV 官方资料

zh: 在開車時，什麼時候打開酒精飲品容器屬於合法？
en: When is it legal for a person to drive with an alcoholic beverage container that has been opened?
options: 倘若容器放置於前排座位下方。
If the container is under the front seat.
倘若容器放置於車後面車箱內。
If the container is in the trunk of the vehicle.
倘若容器放置於手飾箱內。
If the container is in the glove compartment.
notes: 题意与解析　英文题意是“开车携带已经开封的酒类容器，什么情况下合法？”本题问的是存放位置。普通小客车应将其放在后备厢；座椅下和手套箱都位于乘员舱内。
The question concerns where to carry an opened alcohol container. In an ordinary passenger car, put it in the trunk. Under the seat and inside the glove compartment are both in the passenger area.
延伸考点　注意英文的 has been opened 指“已经开封”。题目考存放地点；放在手套箱里仍在乘员舱，锁上也不符合本题要求。选后备厢也不等于驾驶员可以边开车边喝酒。

“Has been opened” describes the condition of the container. A glove compartment remains in the passenger area even when locked. The trunk answer concerns storage and does not permit drinking while driving. DMV 官方资料

en: What is the minimum age to apply for a Class C instruction permit in California?
notes: 普通小客车的未成年人学习许可最早可在十五岁半申请。拿到许可后，仍须遵守有人陪同练车的条件。

en: How long must a minor have an instruction permit before taking the behind-the-wheel drive test?
notes: 未满十八岁时，从取得学习许可起通常至少要等六个月才能参加路考。这段时间用来完成规定的练习。

en: What is the speed limit in a business or residential district unless otherwise posted?
notes: 没有其他限速标志时，商业区和居民区通常限速每小时二十五英里。即使低于上限，也应按视距和行人情况减速。

en: When should you signal before making a turn?
notes: 转弯前至少提前一百英尺打灯，让后车和骑车人有时间判断你的路线。

en: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the road mean?
notes: 黄色标线分隔相反方向的车流。自己一侧为实黄线时，不能跨过去超车；左转进入车道入口适用另一条规则。

en: For a driver age 21 or older operating a personal vehicle, which BAC triggers California's standard per se DUI threshold?
notes: 对年满二十一岁、驾驶普通私家车且没有特别限制的驾驶员，血液酒精浓度达到 0.08% 即触及法定门槛。低于门槛但驾驶能力已受损也可能违法。

en: What is the BAC limit for drivers under 21?
notes: 加州对未满二十一岁驾驶员执行零容忍规则。0.01% 是触发该规则的门槛，即使没有明显醉态也适用。

en: In good conditions, what following interval does the DMV recommend as a starting point?
notes: 在正常条件下，当前车经过固定标志时开始数秒，至少三秒后你的车才到同一点。雨天或视线不佳应增加间距。

en: How close to a fire hydrant can you legally park?
notes: 普通车辆停车时须给消防栓留出至少十五英尺，以便消防人员迅速接上水带。

en: What does a red traffic light mean?
notes: 面对稳定红灯，应在线前完全停稳。是否可以转弯，还取决于箭头、禁转标志和其他道路使用者。

en: At a steady circular red signal, with no sign prohibiting a right turn and a clear path, what should you do before turning right?
options: Stop completely and yield before turning
notes: 普通圆形红灯允许右转的前提是先完全停车、没有禁止标志，并让行人和有优先权的车辆先行。红色箭头另有规定。

en: Which set of checks should you make before changing lanes?
notes: 变道前先打灯，看后视镜，再回头确认盲区。镜子里没有车，不能单独证明旁边的车道安全。

en: How many people are needed to use an HOV lane?
notes: 拼车道入口的标牌会注明所需人数和生效时段。不同路段可能要求两人或三人，计算时包括驾驶员。

en: What does a yield sign mean?
options: Slow down and stop if necessary
notes: 让行标志要求先降低车速，检查可能冲突的车辆、骑车人和行人。没有安全空隙就停下来等待。

en: What does a green arrow traffic light mean?
options: Proceed in the direction of the arrow
notes: 绿箭头允许沿箭头方向行驶；转弯前仍须让已经在路口里的车辆和行人安全离开。

en: What is the speed limit in an alley?
notes: 巷道的视野通常被建筑物或车库遮挡。加州巷道限速为每小时十五英里，有人或障碍物时还应更慢。

en: A pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog:
notes: 白手杖或导盲犬提示驾驶员，行人可能依靠声音判断交通。让其安全通过，不要鸣笛催促。

en: What does a diamond-shaped sign indicate?
notes: 菱形交通标志通常预告危险，例如弯路、湿滑或车道汇入。根据图案提前调整速度和位置。

en: The maximum speed limit for vehicles towing trailers is:
notes: 普通汽车拖挂拖车时，即使同一路段其他车辆的限速更高，拖挂车辆也不得超过每小时五十五英里。

en: When backing up, you should:
notes: 倒车前观察四周，倒车过程中回头查看后方，并辅以后视镜或倒车影像。摄像头拍不到所有盲区。

en: A flashing red traffic light means:
notes: 闪红灯按停车标志处理。完全停稳、依次让行后，在确认安全时通过。

en: What does a broken yellow line mean?
notes: 自己一侧为虚黄线只表示在安全条件下可借对向车道超车。还须能看清来车，并留足回到原车道的距离。

en: What is the speed limit at a blind intersection?
notes: 盲路口缺少足够的横向视距。对符合手册定义的无停车标志盲路口，限速为每小时十五英里。

en: You may cross double solid yellow lines to:
notes: 一道双实黄线通常禁止借对向车道超车，但在安全且允许时可以跨过它左转进入车道入口。两组分隔开的双黄线规则不同。

en: When driving in fog, you should:
notes: 雾滴会把远光反射回驾驶员眼前。在雾中行车宜用近光、降低车速，并留足停车距离。

en: You are dropping off a passenger. What use of a white curb is generally permitted?
notes: 白色路缘允许短时间上下乘客，手册也列有投递邮件的情况。不能把车长时间停在那里等人。

en: An emergency vehicle approaches from behind with its siren and emergency lights on. What should you do once clear of the intersection?
options: Pull to the right and stop
notes: 后方紧急车辆鸣笛并亮起警示灯时，在安全条件下靠右停车让道。若已在路口，先通过路口再靠边。

en: The hand signal for a right turn is:
notes: 驾驶员用左臂打右转手势时，将上臂伸出车窗并向上弯起前臂。与左臂平伸表示左转区分开。

en: You must use your turn signal when:
notes: 转弯和变道都会影响旁车的判断，因此两种动作都要提前打转向灯，并自行确认有安全空间。

en: When parking uphill with a curb, turn your wheels:
notes: 上坡且有路缘时，把前轮转离路缘。车辆后溜时，前轮会抵住路缘，帮助阻止车继续滚动。

en: A yellow traffic light means:
options: Caution - light is about to turn red
notes: 稳定黄灯提醒绿灯结束。能够安全停车就停车；已太近、无法安全停下时谨慎通过，不要加速抢灯。

en: What does a pentagon-shaped sign indicate?
notes: 五边形标志用于提醒学校区域或学校过街点。注意观察儿童、协管员和现场限速标志。

en: When should you use your horn?
notes: 在有必要避免碰撞时可鸣笛提醒。鸣笛不能替代减速、制动或让行。

en: What should you do if you miss your freeway exit?
notes: 错过高速公路出口就继续开到下一出口。突然横切或在路肩倒车，会让高速驶来的车辆来不及反应。

en: When driving in rain, you should:
notes: 雨天轮胎抓地力降低，制动距离增加。拉大跟车距离，便能更早平稳地减速。

en: When must you turn on your headlights because weather conditions require continuous windshield-wiper use?
notes: 恶劣天气需要持续使用雨刷时，应开启前照灯，让其他道路使用者更容易看见你。

en: When approaching a roundabout, you should:
options: Yield to traffic already in the roundabout
notes: 进入环岛前，先让已经在环岛内的车辆通过。利用足够大的空隙进入，避免迫使环内车辆急刹。

en: When must you change your address with DMV?
notes: 搬家后须在十天内向 DMV 更新地址。仅向邮局办理转寄不能代替通知 DMV。

en: When driving behind a large truck, you should:
notes: 货车会遮住前方路况。加大距离可改善视野，也给自己更多时间应对货车制动。

en: What should you do if your tire blows out?
notes: 爆胎后先握稳方向盘，平稳控制方向并逐步减速。猛刹或突然转向可能让车失控。

en: What is carbon monoxide?
notes: 一氧化碳无色无味，可由发动机废气产生。封闭车库里即使闻不到气味也可能积聚致命浓度。

en: When driving in a work zone, you should:
options: Speed up to get through quickly
notes: 施工区可能有临时车道、设备和近距离作业人员。根据标志减速，服从现场指挥。

en: What does a green curb mean?
notes: 绿色路缘允许限时停车。具体时长看路缘文字或旁边的标志，不能因为车位空着就长时间占用。

en: What is the purpose of anti-lock brakes (ABS)?
notes: 防抱死制动系统能在紧急制动时防止车轮持续锁死，帮助驾驶员保持转向能力。

en: Unless otherwise posted, what is the maximum speed on a two-lane undivided highway?
notes: 未另行标示时，双向两车道、没有中央隔离带的公路通常限速每小时五十五英里。

en: What should you do if you feel drowsy while driving?
notes: 困倦会降低判断和反应能力。在安全地点停下休息；调大音乐或吹风无法可靠地消除困意。

en: What does a yellow curb mean?
notes: 黄色路缘用于限时上下客或装卸货物。应查看现场标志对时段、车辆和停留时间的要求。

en: What should you do at a stop sign?
options: Stop only if traffic is coming
notes: 停车标志要求车轮完全停止。没有统一的“停够三秒”规则，停妥后仍要观察并让行。

en: When backing out of a parking space, you should:
notes: 从车位倒出属于进入现有通行路径。缓慢后退，先让经过的行人和车辆通行。

en: A round yellow warning sign with a black X and the letters RR alerts you to what?
notes: 圆形黄色警告标志预告前方铁路平交道。减速观察，并确认轨道另一侧有足够空间。

en: What should you do if you hydroplane?
notes: 轮胎在积水上滑行时，应平稳松开油门，避免急刹或猛打方向，让轮胎逐步恢复抓地力。

en: What is the hand signal for stopping?
notes: 左臂伸出车窗并向下弯曲，表示准备减速或停车。向上弯曲则表示右转。

en: When changing lanes on a freeway, you should signal:
notes: 在高速公路变道前，转向灯至少提前五秒开启。这是时间要求，与路口转弯前的一百英尺距离要求不同。

en: What does an octagonal road sign mean?
notes: 八角形标志表示停车，即使从背面只看到轮廓也容易辨认。到停止线前停稳后再观察。

en: What does a brown sign indicate?
notes: 棕色指示牌通常指向公园、游憩设施或文化景点，作用是提供目的地信息。

en: When parking next to a curb, you should be within:
notes: 靠路缘平行停车后，靠路缘一侧车轮与路缘之间应在十八英寸以内，以免车辆过度占用行车空间。

en: When approaching a curve, you should:
notes: 进入弯道前先减到能安全转弯的速度。把大部分制动放在入弯前，可减少转弯时突然失去抓地力的风险。

en: What does a flashing yellow arrow mean?
notes: 闪烁黄箭头允许在安全间隙转弯，须先让对向车流和行人。不要把它当作受保护的绿箭头。

en: When parking downhill beside a curb, which way should you turn the front wheels?
notes: 下坡且有路缘时，把前轮转向路缘。车辆若向前滚，车轮会先抵住路缘。

en: What is the hand signal for a left turn?
notes: 将左臂从驾驶侧车窗平直伸出表示左转。向上弯臂表示右转，向下弯臂表示减速或停车。
